plugin.name: SlopeTrain
plugin.author: Kanaye
plugin.purpose: A plugin to help you lead a slope train

muclient.script:
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- DEPENDENCIES & CONSTANTS --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
require("wait") require("async") require("gmcphelper") json = require("json") dofile(GetInfo(60) .. "aardwolf_colors.lua")
PLUGIN_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/st3rv1s/SlopeTrain/refs/heads/main/SlopeTrain.xml" SetVariable("DownloadURL", PLUGIN_URL) PLUGIN_PROTOCOL = "HTTPS" PLUGIN_PREFIX = "[SlopeTrain]" PLUGIN_ID_GMCP_HANDLER = "3e7dedbe37e44942dd46d264"
-- Variable keys for state persistence VAR_CHAN = "chan" VAR_CURRENT_PASS = "current_pass" VAR_TRAIN_MSG = "train_msg" VAR_SLOPE_REPOP = "slope_repop_enabled" VAR_AUTO_BUY_PASS = "auto_buy_pass" VAR_AUTO_NEXT_SLOPE = "auto_next_slope" VAR_REPOP_MSG = "repop_msg"
-- Character state constants CHAR_STATE_STANDING = 3 CHAR_STATE_FIGHTING = 8 CHAR_STATE_SLEEPING = 9 CHAR_STATE_RESTING = 11
-- Room ID constants ROOM_PINNACLE = 38813 ROOM_EPIC_SHOP = 38714
-- Unified slope configuration (consolidates slope_exits, slope_start_rooms, slope_directions) SLOPE_CONFIG = { east = { start = 38814, finish = 38823, enter_cmd = "east", next = "south" }, south = { start = 38825, finish = 38834, enter_cmd = "south", next = "west" }, west = { start = 38836, finish = 38845, enter_cmd = "west", next = "east" } }
-- Follow-the-leader commands (trigger name -> command to send) FOLLOW_COMMANDS = { slingshot = "enter slingshot", kill = "west", hatchery = "east", chutes = "south" }
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- STATE & DEFAULT DATA --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function get_default_messages() return { east = { "@x057[@x038SlopeTrain@x057] @x159CHOO CHOO ALL ABOARD! @W>>> @x214EAST @W>>> @x214Est! @W>>> @x214Oost! @W>>> @x214Timur!$C", }, south = { "@x057[@x038SlopeTrain@x057] @x159CHOO CHOO ALL ABOARD! @Wvvv @x201SOUTH @Wvvv @x201Sud! @Wvvv @x201Zuid! @Wvvv @x201Selatan!$C", }, west = { "@x057[@x038SlopeTrain@x057] @x159CHOO CHOO ALL ABOARD! @W<<< @x082WEST @W<<< @x082Ouest! @W<<< @x082West! @W<<< @x082Barat!$C", } } end
function get_default_repop_message() return { "@C(@x244SlopeTrain@C) @WThe engine just got @GFUELED@W. @x256C@x256H@x256U@x256G@x256G@x256A @x256C@x256H@x256U@x256G@x256G@x256A @x256C@x256H@x256O@x256O @x256C@x256H@x256O@x256O$C" } end
-- Room state tracking (nil = uninitialized) room = { id = nil, name = nil, zone = nil }
-- Character state tracking (nil = uninitialized) character = { state = nil, previous_state = nil }
-- Plugin state variables is_group_leader = false is_in_icefall = false player_name = "" slope_repop_enabled = true chan = "gtell" current_pass = "onedaypass" auto_buy_pass_enabled = false auto_next_slope_enabled = false pending_pass_purchase = nil last_train_msg = nil repop_messages = nil
-- Slope completion tracking (resets on repop) -- visited: entered any room on slope, started: entered start room, finished: entered finish room slope_status = { east = { visited = false, started = false, finished = false }, south = { visited = false, started = false, finished = false }, west = { visited = false, started = false, finished = false } }
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- UTILITY FUNCTIONS --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function gmcp(s) local ret, datastring = CallPlugin(PLUGIN_ID_GMCP_HANDLER, "gmcpdata_as_string", s) if ret ~= 0 or datastring == nil then return nil end local data = nil pcall(function() data = loadstring("return " .. datastring)() end) return data end
function cnote(string) AnsiNote(stylesToANSI(ColoursToStyles(string))) end
function load_state() chan = GetVariable(VAR_CHAN) or "gtell" current_pass = GetVariable(VAR_CURRENT_PASS) or "onedaypass"
local repop = GetVariable(VAR_SLOPE_REPOP) slope_repop_enabled = (repop == nil) or (repop == "true")
local auto_buy = GetVariable(VAR_AUTO_BUY_PASS) auto_buy_pass_enabled = (auto_buy == "true")
local auto_next = GetVariable(VAR_AUTO_NEXT_SLOPE) auto_next_slope_enabled = (auto_next == "true")
local saved_msgs = GetVariable(VAR_TRAIN_MSG) if saved_msgs ~= nil then local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, saved_msgs) if ok and type(decoded) == "table" then if decoded.east ~= nil and decoded.south ~= nil and decoded.west ~= nil then train_messages = decoded elseif #decoded > 0 then train_messages = get_default_messages() else train_messages = get_default_messages() end else train_messages = get_default_messages() end else train_messages = get_default_messages() end
local saved_repop = GetVariable(VAR_REPOP_MSG) if saved_repop ~= nil then local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, saved_repop) if ok and type(decoded) == "table" and #decoded > 0 then repop_messages = decoded else repop_messages = get_default_repop_message() end else repop_messages = get_default_repop_message() end end
function save_state() SetVariable(VAR_CHAN, chan or "gtell") SetVariable(VAR_CURRENT_PASS, current_pass or "onedaypass") SetVariable(VAR_SLOPE_REPOP, tostring(slope_repop_enabled)) SetVariable(VAR_AUTO_BUY_PASS, tostring(auto_buy_pass_enabled)) SetVariable(VAR_AUTO_NEXT_SLOPE, tostring(auto_next_slope_enabled)) if train_messages ~= nil then SetVariable(VAR_TRAIN_MSG, json.encode(train_messages)) end if repop_messages ~= nil then SetVariable(VAR_REPOP_MSG, json.encode(repop_messages)) end end
function reset_slope_status() slope_status = { east = { visited = false, started = false, finished = false }, south = { visited = false, started = false, finished = false }, west = { visited = false, started = false, finished = false } } end
function is_slope_completed(direction) local status = slope_status[direction] return status and status.started and status.finished end
function all_slopes_completed() for direction, _ in pairs(SLOPE_CONFIG) do if not is_slope_completed(direction) then return false end end return true end
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- PLUGIN LIFECYCLE --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function OnPluginInstall() show_helpfile() end
function OnPluginConnect() EnableTimer("timer_init_plugin", true) end
function OnPluginEnable() EnableTimer("timer_init_plugin", true) end
function OnPluginSaveState() save_state() end
function OnPluginBroadcast(msg, id, name, text) if id == PLUGIN_ID_GMCP_HANDLER then if text == "char.base" then local base = gmcp("char.base") if base ~= nil then player_name = base.name or "" end elseif text == "group" then local group_info = gmcp("group") if group_info ~= nil and player_name ~= "" then is_group_leader = (group_info.leader == player_name) end elseif text == "room.info" then on_room_info_update(gmcp("room.info")) elseif text == "char.status" then on_character_status_update(gmcp("char.status")) end end end
function init_plugin() if not IsConnected() then return end
local current_state = gmcp("char.status.state") if current_state == nil then return end if ((current_state ~= "3") and (current_state ~= "8") and (current_state ~= "9") and (current_state ~= "11")) then return end
EnableTimer("timer_init_plugin", false) load_state() reset_slope_status() -- Reset slope tracking on connect/reconnect initialize_from_gmcp()
-- If we're mid-slope on connect, mark as visited (but not started) local current_slope = get_current_slope() if current_slope then slope_status[current_slope].visited = true end end
function initialize_from_gmcp() local room_info = gmcp("room.info") if room_info ~= nil then room.id = tonumber(room_info.num) room.name = room_info.name room.zone = room_info.zone is_in_icefall = (room.zone == "icefall") end
local char_status = gmcp("char.status") if char_status ~= nil then character.state = tonumber(char_status.state) or 0 end
local char_base = gmcp("char.base") if char_base ~= nil then player_name = char_base.name or "" end
local group_info = gmcp("group") if group_info ~= nil and player_name ~= "" then local leader = group_info.leader is_group_leader = (leader ~= nil and leader == player_name) end end
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- EVENT HANDLERS --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function on_room_info_update(room_info) if room_info == nil then return end
local previous_room_id = room.id local previous_zone = room.zone
room.id = tonumber(room_info.num) room.name = room_info.name room.zone = room_info.zone is_in_icefall = (room.zone == "icefall")
if previous_room_id ~= nil and previous_room_id ~= room.id then on_room_change(previous_room_id, room.id) end end
function on_room_change(previous_room_id, new_room_id) if new_room_id == nil then return end
-- Handle pending pass purchase if pending_pass_purchase then local pass = pending_pass_purchase local expected_room = (pass == "onedaypass") and ROOM_PINNACLE or ROOM_EPIC_SHOP if new_room_id == expected_room then pending_pass_purchase = nil EnableTimer("timer_pass_purchase_timeout", false) buy_pass(pass) end end
-- Track slope completion status (for all players) for direction, config in pairs(SLOPE_CONFIG) do if new_room_id >= config.start and new_room_id <= config.finish then slope_status[direction].visited = true if new_room_id == config.start then slope_status[direction].started = true elseif new_room_id == config.finish then slope_status[direction].finished = true end end end
-- Slope announcements only for group leader if not is_group_leader then return end
-- Announce when arriving at a slope start for direction, config in pairs(SLOPE_CONFIG) do if new_room_id == config.start then slope_success(direction) return end end end
function on_character_status_update(status) if status == nil then return end
character.previous_state = character.state character.state = tonumber(status.state)
if character.previous_state ~= nil and character.state ~= nil and character.previous_state ~= character.state then on_state_change(character.previous_state, character.state) end end
function on_state_change(previous_state, new_state) -- Auto-advance to next slope when exiting combat at slope finish (leader only) if auto_next_slope_enabled and is_group_leader and previous_state == CHAR_STATE_FIGHTING and new_state == CHAR_STATE_STANDING then for direction, config in pairs(SLOPE_CONFIG) do if room.id == config.finish then local next_slope = config.next
-- Check if next slope is already completed if is_slope_completed(next_slope) then if all_slopes_completed() then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @RAll slopes completed. Waiting for repop...") else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @RAuto-next: " .. next_slope:sub(1,1):upper() .. next_slope:sub(2) .. " already done. Try manually.") end return end
Note("[SlopeTrain] Auto-advancing to " .. next_slope:sub(1,1):upper() .. next_slope:sub(2) .. " slope...") Execute("mapper goto " .. SLOPE_CONFIG[next_slope].start) return end end end end
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- SLOPE FUNCTIONALITY --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function get_current_slope() if room.id == nil then return nil end
for direction, config in pairs(SLOPE_CONFIG) do if room.id >= config.start and room.id <= config.finish then return direction end end
return nil end
function get_location_status() if not is_in_icefall then return "@RNot in Icefall" end
local slope = get_current_slope() if slope then return slope:sub(1,1):upper() .. slope:sub(2) .. " Slope" else return "Icefall (not on slope)" end end
function enter_slope(name, line, wildcards) if character.state == nil or character.state == CHAR_STATE_FIGHTING then Note("[SlopeTrain] " .. (character.state == nil and "State unknown." or "In combat.") .. " Movement blocked.") return end
local config = SLOPE_CONFIG[name] if not config then Note("[SlopeTrain] Unknown direction: " .. name) return end
-- Check if slope is already completed if is_slope_completed(name) then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @R" .. name:sub(1,1):upper() .. name:sub(2) .. " slope already completed this repop. Waiting for repop...") return end
Execute("mapper goto " .. config.start) end
function move_next_slope_room() local current_slope = get_current_slope()
if current_slope == nil then Note("[SlopeTrain] You must be on a slope to use this command.") Note("[SlopeTrain] Current room: " .. tostring(room.id or "Unknown")) return end
local next_slope = SLOPE_CONFIG[current_slope].next
-- Check if next slope is already completed if is_slope_completed(next_slope) then if all_slopes_completed() then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @RAll slopes completed this repop. Waiting for repop...") else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @R" .. next_slope:sub(1,1):upper() .. next_slope:sub(2) .. " slope already completed. Try a different slope.") end return end
Note("[SlopeTrain] Moving from " .. current_slope:sub(1,1):upper() .. current_slope:sub(2) .. " to " .. next_slope:sub(1,1):upper() .. next_slope:sub(2) .. " slope...") Execute("mapper goto " .. SLOPE_CONFIG[next_slope].start) end
function slope_success(direction) if train_messages == nil or train_messages[direction] == nil then train_messages = get_default_messages() end if chan == nil or chan == "" then chan = "gtell" end
local dir_messages = train_messages[direction] local slope_msg = dir_messages[math.random(1, #dir_messages)] last_train_msg = slope_msg SendNoEcho(chan .. " " .. slope_msg) end
function follow_the_leader(name, line, wildcards) if wildcards[1] == gmcp("group.leader") then SendNoEcho(FOLLOW_COMMANDS[name]) end end
function repeat_train_direction() if not is_in_icefall then Note("[SlopeTrain] You can only repeat directions in Icefall.") return end
if last_train_msg then local channel = chan or "gtell" SendNoEcho(channel .. " " .. last_train_msg) Note("[SlopeTrain] Repeating last direction") else Note("[SlopeTrain] No previous direction to repeat.") end end
function slope_repop() -- Check if we're currently mid-slope before resetting local current_slope = get_current_slope()
-- Reset slope completion tracking on repop reset_slope_status()
-- If we were mid-slope, mark as visited (but not started, since we didn't enter from start) if current_slope then slope_status[current_slope].visited = true end
-- Only send repop message if enabled if not slope_repop_enabled then return end
if not chan or chan == "" then ColourNote("red", "", "SlopeTrain: Channel is not set. Use 'slopetrain channel' to set one.") return end
if is_group_leader then if repop_messages == nil or #repop_messages == 0 then repop_messages = get_default_repop_message() end local msg = repop_messages[math.random(1, #repop_messages)] SendNoEcho(chan .. " " .. msg) end end
function expired_pass_action() local pass = current_pass or "onedaypass" local shop_room = (pass == "onedaypass") and ROOM_PINNACLE or ROOM_EPIC_SHOP
if not auto_buy_pass_enabled then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @WYour pass has expired!") if pass == "onedaypass" then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @WPurchase a new pass at: @CPinnacle (mapper goto " .. ROOM_PINNACLE .. ")") else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] @WPurchase a new pass at: @CEpic Shop (mapper goto " .. ROOM_EPIC_SHOP .. ")") end return end
if room.id == shop_room then buy_pass(pass) else pending_pass_purchase = pass EnableTimer("timer_pass_purchase_timeout", true) Note("[SlopeTrain] Navigating to shop to buy " .. pass .. "...") Execute("mapper goto " .. shop_room) end end
function buy_pass(pass) if pass == "250usespass" then SendNoEcho("buy 250usespass") elseif pass == "oneweekpass" then SendNoEcho("buy oneweekpass") elseif pass == "onedaypass" then SendNoEcho("buy onedaypass") end SendNoEcho("keyring put pass") Note("[SlopeTrain] Pass purchased and added to keyring.")
if room.id ~= ROOM_PINNACLE then Note("[SlopeTrain] Returning to Pinnacle...") Execute("mapper goto " .. ROOM_PINNACLE) end end
function cancel_pending_pass_purchase() if pending_pass_purchase then Note("[SlopeTrain] Pass purchase timed out (30s). Cancelling.") pending_pass_purchase = nil end end
function toggle_pass_type() local pass_ids = {"250usespass", "oneweekpass", "onedaypass"} local current_index = 0
for i, pass in ipairs(pass_ids) do if pass == current_pass then current_index = i break end end
local next_index = (current_index % #pass_ids) + 1 current_pass = pass_ids[next_index] save_state()
local display_formats = { ["250usespass"] = "@W[@G250 Uses @RPass@W]", oneweekpass = "@W[@COne Week @RPass@W]", onedaypass = "@W[@yOne Day @RPass@W]" }
cnote(string.format("@b[SlopeTrain] Pass type toggled. Current pass type: %s", display_formats[current_pass])) end
function toggle_auto_buy_pass() auto_buy_pass_enabled = not auto_buy_pass_enabled save_state() if auto_buy_pass_enabled then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Auto-buy pass is now @GON") else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Auto-buy pass is now @ROFF @W(will notify only)") end end
function toggle_auto_next_slope() auto_next_slope_enabled = not auto_next_slope_enabled save_state() if auto_next_slope_enabled then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Auto-next slope is now @GON") else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Auto-next slope is now @ROFF") end end
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- COMMANDS & UI --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function set_slope_message() if train_messages == nil then train_messages = get_default_messages() end
local current_content = "=== EAST ===\r\n" .. table.concat(train_messages.east or {}, "\r\n") .. "\r\n\r\n=== SOUTH ===\r\n" .. table.concat(train_messages.south or {}, "\r\n") .. "\r\n\r\n=== WEST ===\r\n" .. table.concat(train_messages.west or {}, "\r\n")
local messages = utils.editbox( "Custom slope messages per direction.\nOne message per line under each section.\nTo prevent color bleeding end with $C.", "Slope Notifications", current_content )
if not messages then Note("[SlopeTrain] No custom messages or user cancelled. Keeping existing messages.") return end
local new_messages = { east = {}, south = {}, west = {} } local current_section = nil
for line in messages:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do local trimmed = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if trimmed == "=== EAST ===" then current_section = "east" elseif trimmed == "=== SOUTH ===" then current_section = "south" elseif trimmed == "=== WEST ===" then current_section = "west" elseif current_section ~= nil and trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(new_messages[current_section], trimmed) end end
local defaults = get_default_messages() if #new_messages.east == 0 then new_messages.east = defaults.east Note("[SlopeTrain] No East messages entered. Using default.") end if #new_messages.south == 0 then new_messages.south = defaults.south Note("[SlopeTrain] No South messages entered. Using default.") end if #new_messages.west == 0 then new_messages.west = defaults.west Note("[SlopeTrain] No West messages entered. Using default.") end
train_messages = new_messages save_state() Note("[SlopeTrain] Saved custom messages for all directions.") end
function set_repop_message() if repop_messages == nil then repop_messages = get_default_repop_message() end
local current_content = table.concat(repop_messages, "\r\n")
local messages = utils.editbox( "Custom repop messages (one per line).\nA random message will be sent on each repop.\nTo prevent color bleeding end with $C.", "Repop Notifications", current_content )
if not messages then Note("[SlopeTrain] No custom messages or user cancelled. Keeping existing messages.") return end
local new_messages = {} for line in messages:gmatch("[^\r\n]+") do local trimmed = line:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(new_messages, trimmed) end end
if #new_messages == 0 then new_messages = get_default_repop_message() Note("[SlopeTrain] No messages entered. Using default.") end
repop_messages = new_messages save_state() Note("[SlopeTrain] Saved " .. #repop_messages .. " custom repop message(s).") end
function set_channel_cmd(new_channel) chan = new_channel save_state() cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Changed report channel to: @C" .. chan) end
function toggle_slope_repop() slope_repop_enabled = not slope_repop_enabled save_state() if slope_repop_enabled then cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Repop message is now @GON") else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Repop message is now @ROFF") end end
function alias_slopetrain(name, line, wildcards) local args = wildcards[1] or "" local parts = {} for word in args:gmatch("%S+") do table.insert(parts, word) end
local cmd = (parts[1] and parts[1]:lower()) or "help" table.remove(parts, 1)
if cmd == "help" then show_helpfile() elseif cmd == "update" then local subcmd = (parts[1] and parts[1]:lower()) or "check" if subcmd == "check" then update_check_alias() elseif subcmd == "install" then update_install_alias() else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Usage: slopetrain update [check|install]") end elseif cmd == "set" then local subcmd = (parts[1] and parts[1]:lower()) or "" if subcmd == "msg" then set_slope_message() elseif subcmd == "repop" then set_repop_message() elseif subcmd == "pass" then toggle_pass_type() elseif subcmd == "autobuy" then toggle_auto_buy_pass() elseif subcmd == "autonext" then toggle_auto_next_slope() else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Usage: slopetrain set [msg|repop|pass|autobuy|autonext]") end elseif cmd == "channel" then local channel = parts[1] if channel ~= nil and channel ~= "" then set_channel_cmd(channel) else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Current channel: @C" .. (chan or "gtell")) end elseif cmd == "repop" then toggle_slope_repop() elseif cmd == "status" then show_status() elseif cmd == "reload" then reload_slopetrain() else cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Unknown command: @R" .. cmd) show_helpfile() end end
function show_helpfile() cnote("") cnote("@W @RIMPORTANT: SETUP YOUR CEXITS! @w") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Helpfile@W]--------------------@C+@w") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain - ", "white", "", "Shows this helpfile") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain help - ", "white", "", "Shows this helpfile") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain reload - ", "white", "", "Reload the plugin") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain update check - ", "white", "", "Check your current version") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain update install - ", "white", "", "Install latest version") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Setup@W]------------------------@C+@w") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain status - ", "white", "", "Show all current settings") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain set msg - ", "white", "", "Setup your own slope messages") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain set repop - ", "white", "", "Setup your own repop messages") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain set pass - ", "white", "", "Toggle between type of pass") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain set autobuy - ", "white", "", "Toggle auto-buy pass (default: off)") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain set autonext - ", "white", "", "Toggle auto-next slope (default: off)") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain repop - ", "white", "", "Turn on/off the repop message") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "slopetrain channel <chan> - ", "white", "", "Set repop channel: ", "cyan", "", chan or "gtell") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Commands@W]---------------------@C+@w") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "icee - ", "white", "", "Move the train to the East slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "ices - ", "white", "", "Move the train to the South slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "icew - ", "white", "", "Move the train to the West slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "icenxt - ", "white", "", "Move to the next slope") ColourNote("lightcyan", "", "repdir - ", "white", "", "Manually repeat the last direction") ColourNote("white", "", "", "white", "", "") cnote("@C+@W-------------------[@CSlopeTrain Helpfile@W]---------------------@C+@w") cnote("") end
function show_status() cnote("@C+@W--------------------[@CSlopeTrain Status@W]--------------------@C+@w") cnote("@WChannel: @C" .. (chan or "gtell")) cnote("@WPass Type: @C" .. (current_pass or "onedaypass")) cnote("@WAuto-Buy Pass: " .. (auto_buy_pass_enabled and "@GON" or "@ROFF (notify only)")) cnote("@WAuto-Next Slope: " .. (auto_next_slope_enabled and "@GON" or "@ROFF")) cnote("@WRepop Notify: " .. (slope_repop_enabled and "@GON" or "@ROFF")) cnote("@WRepop Messages: @C" .. tostring(#(repop_messages or {})) .. " message(s)") cnote("@WGroup Leader: " .. (is_group_leader and "@GYes" or "@RNo")) cnote("@WLocation: @C" .. get_location_status()) cnote("@WCurrent Room: @C" .. tostring(room.id or "Unknown")) cnote("@WPlayer Name: @C" .. (player_name or "Unknown")) cnote("@C+@W----------------------[@CSlope Status@W]-----------------------@C+@w") -- Use ipairs with explicit array for deterministic order: East, South, West for _, direction in ipairs({"east", "south", "west"}) do local status = slope_status[direction] local display_dir = direction:sub(1,1):upper() .. direction:sub(2) local label = string.format("%-16s", display_dir .. ":") if is_slope_completed(direction) then cnote("@W" .. label .. " @GCompleted") elseif status.visited then cnote("@W" .. label .. " @YIn Progress") else cnote("@W" .. label .. " @CAvailable") end end cnote("@C+@W-----------------------------------------------------------@C+@w") end
function reload_slopetrain() cnote("@b[SlopeTrain] Reloading plugin...") reload_plugin() end
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- UPDATE SYSTEM --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function update_check_alias() update_plugin("check") ColourNote("white", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " Checking for updated version...") end
function update_install_alias() update_plugin("install") ColourNote("white", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " Checking for and installing updated version...") end
function reload_plugin() local scriptPrefix = GetAlphaOption("script_prefix")
if scriptPrefix == "" then scriptPrefix = "\\\\\\" SetAlphaOption("script_prefix", scriptPrefix) end
Execute(scriptPrefix .. "DoAfterSpecial(0.5, \"ReloadPlugin('" .. GetPluginID() .. "')\", sendto.script)") end
function update_plugin(mode) update_mode = mode wait.make(get_plugin_file) end
function get_plugin_file() local urlThread = async.request(PLUGIN_URL, PLUGIN_PROTOCOL)
if not urlThread then ColourNote("red", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " Couldn't create async url request.") return end
local timeout = 10 local totTime = 0 while urlThread:alive() and totTime < timeout do wait.time(0.1) totTime = totTime + 0.1 end
local remoteRet, pluginData, status, headers, fullStatus = urlThread:join()
if not status then ColourNote("red", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " Couldn't download plugin file. No status code.") return end
if status ~= 200 then ColourNote("red", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " Plugin file request status code: " .. status .. ": " .. fullStatus) return end
local currentVersion = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 19) or 0 local currentVerStr = tostring(currentVersion) local remoteVerStr = string.match(pluginData, '%s%s+version="([0-9%.]+)"') local remoteVersion = tonumber(remoteVerStr or "") or 0
if remoteVersion == currentVersion then ColourNote("white", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " You are running the most recent version (v" .. currentVerStr .. ")") elseif remoteVersion < currentVersion then ColourNote("white", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " You have a newer version than is publicly available. (v" .. currentVerStr .. ")") elseif update_mode == "check" then ColourNote("white", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " You are running v" .. currentVerStr .. ", but there's a newer version v" .. remoteVerStr) elseif update_mode == "install" then ColourNote("white", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " Updating plugin from version " .. currentVerStr .. " to version " .. remoteVerStr)
local pluginFile = GetPluginInfo(GetPluginID(), 6) local file = io.open(pluginFile, "wb") file:write(pluginData) file:close() reload_plugin() else ColourNote("red", "", PLUGIN_PREFIX .. " Invalid update mode: " .. update_mode) end end
